messages:
Jia Chen: Pinging eng-ml — kicking off Solaris-13B onboarding. Quick smoke found a prefix/kv mismatch after ~512 tokens when running q4_0 on runtime-v2 with rotary RoPE enabled. Sharing logs and short repro below.

Omar Vasquez: Which artifact did you convert? HF checkpoint or internal optimized bundle?

Jia Chen: Converted from hf/solaris-13b-v1 using our convert_v2 script (sha: a1b2c3). Repro command: `./serve --model solaris-13b --quant q4_0 --seq 1024 --runtime runtime-v2`

Mike D: I can reproduce on acolyte-rt1 with seq=1024 + q4_0. After ~512 tokens the model starts echoing earlier context and tokens shift — KV indices look off.

Elaine Park: Can you paste a minimal prompt that reproduces? Also run with `KVCACHE_DEBUG=1` and paste the snippet of kv logs.

Jia Chen: Minimal repro: short system + repeated user paragraph (repeat ~6x to hit 600 tokens). Logs snippet:
```
[2025-07-15T14:12:03Z] kv_step=511 kv_idx=511 expected_idx=511
[2025-07-15T14:12:03Z] kv_step=512 kv_idx=256 expected_idx=512  <-- mismatch
[2025-07-15T14:12:03Z] rotary.phase=0.785 -> 0.392 (interpolated)
[2025-07-15T14:12:04Z] output: "...previous context repeated..."
```
This only happens with q4_0. q8_0 looked fine in quick smoke.

Mike D: Interesting — I also saw it only when `rotary.phase_interpolate=true`. With that off, q4_0 stops reproducing the drift.

Omar Vasquez: My guess is quant packing changed aligned offsets used by the attention kernel, and rotary phase interpolation depends on exact positional alignment. Try q5_0 or q8_0 to isolate whether it's quant-level packing.

Jia Chen: Confirmed: q8_0 => no issue, q5_0 => intermittent. Marking reproducible for q4_0. Filing intake as P2 for now (not blocking launch but needs root cause).

deploy-bot: New ticket created: ML-2317 Solaris-13B q4_0 KV phase drift. Link: https://redwood.internal/ML-2317

Elaine Park: I'll add a small unit test in runtime that dumps per-step kv hashes and rotary-phase value so we can assert monotonicity. @Mike D can you run a bisect across convert_v2 changes and quantize-tool versions?

Mike D: On it — starting bisect between convert_v2@a1b2c3 and convert_v2@d4e5f6 plus quant-tool v0.9 -> v1.2. ETA this afternoon. :hourglass: 

qa-triage-bot: Labels applied: runtime-compat, quant, kvcache. Assigned to eng-ml.

Jia Chen: Thanks team. I'll attach the full reproduce script and sample hf checkpoint to the ticket. Will update when Mike posts bisect results. :thumbsup:
